selectedFunctions.label: Clearpool Deposit USDC for cpOLEA shares
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime configuration, KYC, liquidity, pause, rate, authority or successful-execution guarantee. Both admitted ordinary calls require zero native value; grants, canonical calldata and independent controls remain mandatory.

Clearpool Olea trade-finance vault on Ethereum is cpOLEA BoringVault 0xa3dbe1b752598f7f8d88caf415ff62b94d7c6d23, not the deprecated Dynamic V1 pools or unsupported-chain credit pools. Official current app metadata binds Teller 0xf6329c02c8ea0baa69c30d2ad4278762d8a72968 and AtomicQueue 0x446fa8a15aadce2896a3909dc68b9148b3dc0fcf. All reviewed contracts are direct deployments; no proxy interface substitution is used.

Olea is a KYC-required offering in the official active lending directory; onboarding contact in app configuration is legal@cicada.partners. Teller supports DISABLED / KEYRING_KYC / MANUAL_WHITELIST modes plus contract whitelist exceptions. deposit is also requiresAuth, so public-call authorization and account eligibility remain runtime requirements, not grants supplied by catalog admission. Clearpool regional/legal restrictions remain applicable.

Underlying/base asset is Ethereum USDC (6 decimals); cpOLEA shares have 6 decimals, while accountant rates use 18 decimals. deposit(asset,amount,minimumMint) checkpoints the accountant, applies asset pricing and cap, pulls assets through BoringVault from caller, and mints shares to caller. USDC must be approved to BoringVault, NOT to Teller. Supply a meaningful minimumMint; the public app uses zero, which is not a slippage recommendation. No caller deadline exists on deposit.

Share transfers may remain locked by Teller shareUnlockTime; new deposits reset that user unlock time. Governed shareLockPeriod is bounded by 3 days in reviewed source. Authorized refunder may revert eligible deposits during the recorded lock period; refundDeposit is privileged and not admitted. Accountant fees, asset support, cap, pause and authority settings remain mutable. Official observed UI quotes 0.50% management fee and 1,000,000-USDC maximum deposit; these are offchain UI observations, not fresh onchain state.

updateAtomicRequest(offer,want,deadline,offerAmount) only creates/replaces the caller's request for a token pair and transfers no tokens itself. Intended withdrawal pair is cpOLEA -> USDC. Keep shares in the wallet and approve AtomicQueue for their eventual transfer; requests can be made without sufficient balance/allowance but then cannot settle. Zero offerAmount cancels; updating a pair replaces its prior amount/deadline. No claim transaction is required after a solver transfers output directly to the requester.

Withdrawals are asynchronous solver-filled requests, not BoringVault instant exits. Observed Olea app terms show 30-day notice and 37-day total withdrawal deadline (30+7). The deployed AtomicQueue has only an expiry deadline, NOT an onchain earliest-fill notice check; those business terms are not guaranteed by updateAtomicRequest. Fill timing, eligible authorized solver, liquidity and payer transfers are not guaranteed; after expiry the request can no longer be filled unless updated.

AtomicQueue computes output at accountant.getRate() at solve time with decimal conversion/rounding; its request ABI has NO minPrice/minAssets/slippage bound, despite the event field named minPrice (emitted as 0). The caller-selected offer/want tokens are not pinned in updateAtomicRequest. Arbitrary solver/runData solve(), BoringVault manage(), administrative enter/exit, bulk solver flows, LayerZero bridge/callbacks and permit are all excluded; admission is not a complete-workflow or financial-safety assurance.

Official October 2026 CPOOL-to-CLEAR migration notice concerns governance-token migration and XRPL expansion; it is not treated as evidence that this currently ACTIVE Ethereum Olea offering is retired. No token-migration or XRPL capability is admitted.

withdrawalRequest.requestStorage: userAtomicRequest[msg.sender][offer][want] = deadline,offerAmount; no token transfer and no opaque downstream payload. It does not validate token pair, eligibility, balance, allowance or future solve readiness.
withdrawalRequest.cancellation: Zero offerAmount invalidates fill; replacing the same pair replaces deadline/amount. Expired nonzero requests need update to become fillable again.
withdrawalRequest.settlement: Separate authorized solver invokes solve; queue transfers offer from requester to solver, invokes solver finishSolve(runData,...) and then atomically transfers want from solver to requester. All solver/callback execution is excluded. User has no separate post-fill claim call.
withdrawalRequest.pricing: No minPrice field exists in AtomicRequest or updateAtomicRequest ABI. Event minPrice is hardcoded 0. At solve, getRate and decimal-normalized account rateProvider data determine want amount; zero output reverts. cpOLEA->USDC payout is rounded-down share value at current accountant.getRate().
withdrawalRequest.noticeAndExpiry: App config noticePeriod=30 days; withdrawalDeadline=7 extra days. UI shows total 37 days and SDK converts total duration to deadline. AtomicQueue enforces only latest expiry, no not-before/notice interval; business service terms are not EVM-enforced by updateAtomicRequest.
withdrawalRequest.approvalsAndBalance: Hold enough shares and maintain approval to queue until settlement. Multiple requests sharing an offer asset require enough aggregate allowance/balance. Deposit share locks can prevent queue transfer.

requirements: Official Olea lending row requires KYC
Deposit source checks requiresAuth plus mode-specific Keyring/manual-whitelist/contract-whitelist
Queue request itself is public and is not proof of investor eligibility or ability to settle
eligibility.accessModeCaveat: Current access-control storage/roles not queried; ABI and offchain ACTIVE metadata cannot prove permissions for an arbitrary caller.

feesAndMaturity.observedManagementFee: Official UI 0.50%, metadata managementFee 50; mutable and not RPC-observed. Source accountant.checkpoint updates fee/rate accounting used by deposits.
feesAndMaturity.maturity: Open credit offering with documented asynchronous notice/expiry, not a fixed-date maturity redemption vault. No immediate exit or scheduled payout guarantee.
feesAndMaturity.minimums: deposit requires nonzero amount and caller minimumMint; queue request can store zero to cancel but solve rejects zero offer/output. No unobserved numerical minimum deposit is asserted.

excludedSurfaces: BoringVault enter/exit are privileged accounting/token movement, not ordinary ERC4626 operations
BoringVault manage single and batch allow arbitrary target/data/value
Teller bulkDeposit/bulkWithdraw are requiresAuth solver/off-ramp flows
refundDeposit is a privileged deposit refunder function, not a public withdrawal
LayerZero bridge, depositAndBridge, lzReceive and related administration are excluded
AtomicQueue solve accepts arbitrary solver and opaque runData; AtomicSolver finishSolve/cross-settlement surfaces excluded
All approvals, permits, ownership, authority, KYC administration, chain/peer configuration, pauses and read-only getters excluded
limitations: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime configuration, KYC, liquidity, pause, rate, authority or successful-execution guarantee. Both admitted ordinary calls require zero native value; grants, canonical calldata and independent controls remain mandatory.

Clearpool Olea trade-finance vault on Ethereum is cpOLEA BoringVault 0xa3dbe1b752598f7f8d88caf415ff62b94d7c6d23, not the deprecated Dynamic V1 pools or unsupported-chain credit pools. Official current app metadata binds Teller 0xf6329c02c8ea0baa69c30d2ad4278762d8a72968 and AtomicQueue 0x446fa8a15aadce2896a3909dc68b9148b3dc0fcf. All reviewed contracts are direct deployments; no proxy interface substitution is used.

Olea is a KYC-required offering in the official active lending directory; onboarding contact in app configuration is legal@cicada.partners. Teller supports DISABLED / KEYRING_KYC / MANUAL_WHITELIST modes plus contract whitelist exceptions. deposit is also requiresAuth, so public-call authorization and account eligibility remain runtime requirements, not grants supplied by catalog admission. Clearpool regional/legal restrictions remain applicable.

Underlying/base asset is Ethereum USDC (6 decimals); cpOLEA shares have 6 decimals, while accountant rates use 18 decimals. deposit(asset,amount,minimumMint) checkpoints the accountant, applies asset pricing and cap, pulls assets through BoringVault from caller, and mints shares to caller. USDC must be approved to BoringVault, NOT to Teller. Supply a meaningful minimumMint; the public app uses zero, which is not a slippage recommendation. No caller deadline exists on deposit.

Share transfers may remain locked by Teller shareUnlockTime; new deposits reset that user unlock time. Governed shareLockPeriod is bounded by 3 days in reviewed source. Authorized refunder may revert eligible deposits during the recorded lock period; refundDeposit is privileged and not admitted. Accountant fees, asset support, cap, pause and authority settings remain mutable. Official observed UI quotes 0.50% management fee and 1,000,000-USDC maximum deposit; these are offchain UI observations, not fresh onchain state.

updateAtomicRequest(offer,want,deadline,offerAmount) only creates/replaces the caller's request for a token pair and transfers no tokens itself. Intended withdrawal pair is cpOLEA -> USDC. Keep shares in the wallet and approve AtomicQueue for their eventual transfer; requests can be made without sufficient balance/allowance but then cannot settle. Zero offerAmount cancels; updating a pair replaces its prior amount/deadline. No claim transaction is required after a solver transfers output directly to the requester.

Withdrawals are asynchronous solver-filled requests, not BoringVault instant exits. Observed Olea app terms show 30-day notice and 37-day total withdrawal deadline (30+7). The deployed AtomicQueue has only an expiry deadline, NOT an onchain earliest-fill notice check; those business terms are not guaranteed by updateAtomicRequest. Fill timing, eligible authorized solver, liquidity and payer transfers are not guaranteed; after expiry the request can no longer be filled unless updated.

AtomicQueue computes output at accountant.getRate() at solve time with decimal conversion/rounding; its request ABI has NO minPrice/minAssets/slippage bound, despite the event field named minPrice (emitted as 0). The caller-selected offer/want tokens are not pinned in updateAtomicRequest. Arbitrary solver/runData solve(), BoringVault manage(), administrative enter/exit, bulk solver flows, LayerZero bridge/callbacks and permit are all excluded; admission is not a complete-workflow or financial-safety assurance.

Official October 2026 CPOOL-to-CLEAR migration notice concerns governance-token migration and XRPL expansion; it is not treated as evidence that this currently ACTIVE Ethereum Olea offering is retired. No token-migration or XRPL capability is admitted.
